summary.zh: 用 pytest 搭可维护的测试体系
summary.en: Build pytest suites with fixtures, mocks and TDD habits.

description.zh: 讲解 pytest 的 fixture、mock 和测试驱动开发的组织方式，帮项目建立可维护的测试套件。写单元测试、搭测试目录，或给存量项目补测试时使用。
description.en: Organises pytest fixtures, mocking and test-driven workflows into a maintainable suite. Use it when writing unit tests, setting up a test layout or adding coverage to an existing codebase.
